title: Regularity of the Sz.-Nagy and Foiaş Factorization of Characteristic Functions and Its Multivariable Analogue
summary: Given a contraction with an invariant subspace and a row contraction with a joint invariant subspace, a factorization of their characteristic functions was obtained by Sz.-Nagy and Foiaş, and by Haria, Maji, and Sarkar, respectively. In this article, we investigate the regularity of this factorization in both the single-variable and multivariable cases. We construct examples of a contraction $T$ with an invariant subspace such that this factorization is not regular in general.
